instruction: Apply only the supplied policy guidance. Do not invent project governance. For every case give an allowed solution set rather than a universal technology answer, identify prohibited failures, select one allowed choice when the facts support it, and preserve intentional implementation freedom.

facts: repository-path-safety plus atomic-file-owner already implements containment, no-follow parents and same-directory rename.
A new owner-local checkpoint needs exactly those primitives plus its own schema policy.
A private tool needs SHA-256 over local bytes.
The runtime standard library provides the required digest and no repository owner exists.
A third-party crypto framework would add 8 MB and a transitive native dependency.
The package already installs and centrally wraps jose for JWT verification.
A proposed 20-line implementation only base64-decodes claims and does not verify signature, algorithm or issuer.
Two components intentionally use the same semantic brand radius.
The adopted Design Authority already owns one exact shared token for that meaning.
The new component can reference that token without changing its semantics.
Tax rounding and animation easing each contain a three-line clamp-shaped calculation.
They have different owners, change reasons, units and failure boundaries.
A generic clamp facade would couple their evolution.
An internal file format has a closed four-token grammar, no escaping, no untrusted input and exhaustive fixtures.
No installed parser fits the grammar; an external parser package would be larger than the entire feature.
A proposal adds a large utility suite only to perform one standard-library path normalization call.
There is no compatibility or maintenance evidence for the dependency.
A candidate library is GPL-only while this distributable package and its release policy require MIT-compatible dependencies.
A compatible installed library and a standard-library composition both satisfy the bounded requirement.
InvoiceService already owns the retry ceiling and exposes a facade.
A new worker-local constant would duplicate the same stable business rule and bypass the facade.
A contained, non-sensitive manifest codec can be implemented with the standard library, an already-installed strict codec, or a 30-line exhaustively tested owner-local decoder.
All three satisfy platform, license and maintenance constraints; no performance distinction is material.
A standard-library codec and a mature compatible installed codec both fully satisfy the bounded non-sensitive format.
The implementation selects the standard-library codec because it is smaller for this owner.
The installed codec remains a supported legal alternative; neither option exhibits a prohibited failure mode.
